title: Grateful Dead Live at Baton Rouge Int. Speedway on 1969-09-01
lineage: SBD > MC (Ampex C-90 cassette) > DAT > CD-R

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1969 outdoor festival set with a smoking Easy Wind and solid Dark Star, captured in surprisingly clear soundboard quality.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its loose but inspired playing, especially the standout performances of Easy Wind, Morning Dew, Dark Star and Casey Jones. Reviewers note that the soundboard source delivers impressive clarity and ambience despite a few early technical hiccups, making it an enjoyable listen for both collectors and casual fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.5 stars across 15 reviews, with consistent praise for both the musical performance and the surprisingly good sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced; reviewers mention nice ambience from the organ (TC) and overall impressive sound for an old outdoor show, with only minor early glitches on Casey Jones.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Festival set with lively banter and a mix of blues‑heavy jams (e.g., Dark Star > St. Stephen > Eleven) leading into the celebrated Easy Wind; the pacing feels loose but engaging.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work noted for its tone and a possible Proud Mary melodic hint in Casey Jones; praised for tearing it up during jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for humorous stage banter (e.g., "Godammit!" intro) and solid vocal contributions.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) credited on organ for Dark Star ambience; Pigpen likely handling organ on Easy Wind, adding a bluesy vibe.
